The climate in Pleven

Pleven is about 100 m above sea level. The warmest month is August, with an average high of 31°C; the coldest is January, when nights average −2°C. Around 630 mm of precipitation falls in a year on average, most of it in June (about 89 mm).

Pleven lies in the hilly part of the Danubian Plain and has a moderate continental climate with hot summers and cold winters. The city is open to the north, so temperatures drop quickly when cold air arrives, often with snow and wind. Summers are sunny, and most precipitation falls in late spring and early summer.

Best time to visit Pleven

The most pleasant weather in Pleven is usually in May and September: average highs are between 22°C and 26°C, with up to 11 days of rain a month. In July and August it is hot, over 30°C in the afternoon on average.
